steps.name: Set alert
steps.do: Open **Set animal viewing alert**. Choose an exhibit and species, leave dates blank or set them to cover today, and enter alert text.

steps.name: Submit alert
steps.expect: Success “… was given a viewing alert.”

steps.name: Map shows alert
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. Open that animal’s tooltip/banner.

steps.name: Remove alert
steps.do: Open **Remove animal viewing alert**. For **Exhibit**, choose the same exhibit from step 1. In **Species**, type the same species and select it from the suggestions.
steps.expect: Exhibit options include that exhibit because it has a viewing alert. Suggestions include that species because it has a viewing alert. Exhibit and species are selected.
